'''Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Dragonstone)''' is a [[Enchant Crossbow Bolt|bolt enchantment spell]] that requires a [[Magic]] level of 68 to cast. It imbues 10 [[dragonstone bolts]] each cast and turns them into [[dragonstone bolts (e)]] or 10 [[dragonstone dragon bolts]] into 10 [[dragonstone dragon bolts (e)]]. 

The enchantment gives the effect ''Dragon's Breath''. These bolts have a small chance of striking your opponent with effect similar to dragon's breath, being able to hit excessively high amounts of damage. The effect is severely reduced if it's used against [[dragons]], fiery creatures, or a player wielding an [[anti-dragon shield]] or a [[dragonfire shield]]. This makes it a popular bolt to use in [[PvP]], as it can cause massive amounts of damage toward players and make fights quick, but are also expensive to buy.
